messages:
anya: heads-up — new int4 canary (sparrow-mini-int4) failing structured-output schema checks intermittently. Failures show trailing commas and escaped/unescaped mix in tool_call.args.

ravi: frequency? can you paste a sample?

anya: ~0.3% of canary requests. Post-merge buffer that caused consumer parse error:

```
... "tool_calls": [ {
  "id": "t-7",
  "name": "translate",
  "args": {"text": "hello\nworld"}
}, {"id":"t-8","name":"summarize","args":{"text":"line1"}}, , ] ...
```

(note: escaped newline in first args ok, but then duplicate separator ", ," and trailing comma)

noah: double-comma again. Is this the serializer or retry merge?

claire: looks like a corner of the retry path: when a retry emits zero chunks, serializer still wrote a separator. Also saw some cases where args were JSON-escaped twice depending on whether the buffer went through the escape pass.

opsbot: monitoring shows canary cluster c-17 had a brief proxy backpressure window at 2024-10-05T10:21:00Z which may have increased retries. Ticket INF-3490 created.

ravi: mitigation options: (A) make serializer transactional: only write "," after append success, (B) add per-response dedupe by tool_call.id before final emit, (C) sanitizer pass that removes control separators and rejects malformed NDJSON in canary.

anya: propose short-term: C + disable structured streaming for sparrow-mini-int4 canary runs. Medium-term: A + B. I'll open PR for sanitizer + canary gate.

noah: I'll add a small in-canary linter that runs after serialization: validate_json_array_or_ndjson(buf) and fail build if invalid. Also add telemetry metric structured_malformed{model,quant,canary}.

claire: small implementation note: for dedupe use a TTL'd set keyed by tool_call.id to avoid unbounded memory. Also ensure serializer.reset_for_retry() clears separator state.

ravi: agree. For escape consistency, patch retry path to always run model bytes through the same JSON_escape() routine before serializer append. That avoids double-escaping or unescaped control chars.

opsbot: Created INF-3491 assigned to anya and noah, linked INF-3490.

anya: plan: 1) PR w/ sanitizer + canary-linter (today), 2) feature-flag disable structured streaming for this canary cluster (temp), 3) follow-up PR for transactional serializer + retry-path normalization + dedupe (next week). Will upload repro script to eng-ml/canary-repro/ndjson_sanity_repro.sh and paste commands.

ravi: thanks. one more ask 9	please add example of malformed payload to the PR description so reviewers can run quick manual checks.

anya: will do. ping when PRs are up :mag:
